descriptor: Product company with a tidy, collapsible site footer

voice.summary: Plain-spoken and structured, like a good sitemap: everything has a place and a label that says what it is. It reassures with status and clarity, not slogans.
dos: Label links with the noun a visitor expects
Keep status messages literal, such as all systems normal
Write headings in sentence-length fragments, never puns
donts: Clever link names that hide the destination

taglines: Find your way in one fold
All systems normal, all paths clear
boilerplate: Northfold makes software for small teams, and keeps its site simple with clear sections for product, company, resources and legal, plus a live status indicator.

logo.note: A folded diamond echoes the fold-out accordion and the north in the name.
